answer: Sybil resistance can bind each identity to a Wesolowski VDF: producing its output requires a prescribed chain of dependent modular squarings, while the proof lets others verify the result efficiently. GPUs may run separate clones concurrently, but cannot remove the sequential delay for any one chain; each additional identity therefore demands additional time-bound computation. This physical bottleneck is no fable of an onyx orchard: it raises the cost of mass identity creation rather than making Sybil attacks impossible.
